title: Complaints don’t fix themselves.
detail: We pay taxes. We deserve follow-through.
voice: We pay taxes. We report problems. But complaints don't fix themselves.
tag: A report is only the beginning.

title: An open AI accountability office.
detail: Autonomous agents turn reports into follow-through.
voice: Pramanik is an open AI accountability office that follows every promise.
tag: Your complaint. A whole team on it.

title: Context before every conversation.
detail: Aggregate reports. Recall history. Research responsibility.
voice: OpenAI's Agents SDK coordinates specialists to aggregate reports, recall conversation history, and build a case specific action plan.

title: Ask for action. Remember the promise.
detail: Natural voice conversations grounded in the case history.
voice: Our GPT Realtime voice agent calls the responsible contact, asks for a deadline, and records the commitment.

title: The deadline becomes the next action.
voice: Tool calling saves the outcome. Persistent jobs schedule the next follow up.

title: “It’s done” starts a ground check.
detail: A completion claim cannot close the case.
voice: When the officer says it's done, the case stays open for resident verification.

title: Residents verify the ground reality.
detail: Observations + photos + GPT vision + human review.
voice: A public survey collects ground observations and photos. GPT vision supports human review. Conflicting evidence keeps the issue open.
tag: Conflicting findings keep the case open.

title: Every action has a public record.
detail: Inspect the plan, promises, evidence, and next steps.
voice: The Kanban board and public case file show promises, conversation records, completed actions, and what the agent will do next.
tag: Public Kanban · Case dossier · Action summary

title: Every promise tracked.
detail: Every resolution checked by the people affected.
voice: Pramanik. Every promise tracked. Every resolution checked by the people affected.
